description: An interactive Touhou Project character encyclopedia PWA.

topics.title: Flandre Scarlet
topics.text: Flandre is a vampire and the younger sister of Remilia Scarlet. She possesses the power to destroy anything, making her extremely dangerous and powerful.
topics.audioText: Flandre Scarlet is a vampire character known for her destructive powers and childlike personality.

topics.title: Alice Margatroid
topics.text: Alice is a magician who specializes in doll manipulation magic. She lives in the Forest of Magic and is known for her intelligence and tactical abilities.
topics.audioText: Alice Margatroid is a skilled magician who controls magical dolls in combat.

topics.title: Mystia Lorelei
topics.text: Mystia is a harpy known for singing and selling grilled lamprey at night markets. She has a mischievous personality and loves to cause trouble.
topics.audioText: Mystia Lorelei is a cheerful harpy who enjoys singing and selling food.

topics.title: Suwako Moriya
topics.text: Suwako is an earth deity and one of the goddesses of the Moriya Shrine. She has control over frogs and earth-related phenomena.
topics.audioText: Suwako Moriya is a divine goddess with power over the earth and nature.

topics.title: Koishi Komeiji
topics.text: Koishi is the younger sister of Satori Komeiji. She has the ability to close her third eye, allowing her to move unnoticed and avoid detection.
topics.audioText: Koishi Komeiji is a mysterious Satori with the unique ability to hide her presence.
